title: dynamic-sampler
expected_caveat: Legality may differ; compare only equivalent valid programs.
protocol: Run python benchmarks/pipeline/shader_experiments.py --compiler /path/to/glslangValidator. Both arms are complete linked GLSL ES 3.00 stages, except SR01-A intentionally rejected.
Match output within scene-specific visual tolerance before timing.
Warm up; alternate randomized A/B at fixed resolution, frequency policy and identical inputs.
Capture at least 30 GPU timer samples (reject disjoint), bandwidth counters where available and thermal state.
Retain raw captures, device/driver/extensions, compiler logs and negative results.
input_equivalence: A deliberately violates GLSL ES 3.00 constant sampler-array indexing. B selects the same texture for index 0 or 1. No GPU A/B timing is valid for rejected A.

title: incoherent-branch
expected_caveat: Extra sampling in B may regress performance.
protocol: Run python benchmarks/pipeline/shader_experiments.py --compiler /path/to/glslangValidator. Both arms are complete linked GLSL ES 3.00 stages, except SR01-A intentionally rejected.

input_equivalence: Use an even-width target (e.g. 32) so no pixel center has uv.x=0.5. Use complete non-mipmapped texture, nearest filtering and matching sampler state. B samples all pixels and may regress despite reducing explicit branching.

title: variant-cardinality
expected_caveat: Reduced variants affect startup/storage, not necessarily GPU time.

input_equivalence: Each macro combination is semantically identical and uses identical texture/input. GPU timing should not be inferred from variant-count reduction. Compare offline build or application startup/storage separately; driver caches can eliminate repeated work.
